facts.fact: One Citizen Daily reports the SSRA review of its E-Customs reform, which aims to digitise import-export procedures, noting strides in automating customs clearance alongside limited infrastructure and staff capacity gaps.

note: e-Customs is described only as an electronic revenue collection platform; declaration processing is not stated.
Only names South Sudan as a Northern Corridor country; RECTS is cargo tracking, not clearance.

facts.fact: Sudans Post reports South Sudan's trade minister and revenue authority commissioner met on 5 January 2026 to coordinate a four-year, USD 10.8 million EU-funded one-stop border post at Nimule, combining customs automation and electronic clearance, with the design approved.

systems.owner: Ministry of Trade and Industry; South Sudan Revenue Authority
